name: Myth & Allegory Encoding
description: Symbolist dream encoding (Gustave Moreau + Odilon Redon primary). Jewel-like or twilight atmospheres, mythic transformation as private psychological vision, decadent strange beauty. Backgrounds are flexible and varied (ominous, surreal, ethereal, architectural, void) rather than locked to one forest type. Strong spatial integration language retained but lighting is open.

prompt_terms.term: jewel-like rich color or twilight gloom
mythic transformation as private psychological vision
erotic charge carried by symbol and atmosphere rather than anatomy
figure fully integrated into the scene not pasted in front
shared light source between figure and environment
flexible mythic background: ominous OR surreal OR ethereal OR architectural void

content.notes: 2026-08-12 — reverted to Symbolist Moreau/Redon core; flexible backgrounds with high variance; spatial integration retained
